tasks.title: Establish the Ghidra baseline and inventory
tasks.instructions: Future run only: follow docs/ghidra.md; verify the stock input, pin Ghidra and Java versions and hashes, check the memory map and ARM/Thumb transitions, export function metadata and local evidence packets. Report unresolved regions and coverage denominator. Propose functions.json; do not populate the shared queue or claim complete discovery. Do not decompile functions in this bootstrap assignment.
tasks.acceptance: Reviewer can reproduce import and export; address and mode anchors checked; unclassified regions and limitations explicit; no device access.

tasks.title: Research the original compiler and ABI
tasks.instructions: Research compiler/version/ABI candidates using the historical SDK provenance and vendor documentation. Record tool sources, availability and hashes; distinguish evidence from guesses. Propose a small later calibration experiment. Do not decompile firmware or install proprietary compilers without a legitimate source.
tasks.acceptance: Evidence-backed candidates, ABI uncertainties and reproducible next experiment; unknowns remain unknown.

tasks.title: Design and prototype an independent matching verifier
tasks.instructions: Use synthetic inputs to prototype compile/link/compare verification as specified in docs/workflow.md. Include a deliberately wrong candidate and fail-closed unknown toolchain handling. Propose integration files; do not modify shared tools, baseline or expected bytes. No real firmware decompilation.
tasks.acceptance: Synthetic negative controls fail; relocation/call targets, literal pools, data and whole-image limitations covered. Prototype is not a stock matching build.
